title: Affineness of the maximal etale locus over excellent regular schemes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof must show the etale locus is affine even when its complement is not a divisor. It localizes over the regular target, uses purity and Hartshorne-Lichtenbaum vanishing to bound the structure-sheaf cohomological dimension of the locus, then applies the prior local affineness criterion to finish the dimension induction.
